blocks.actual: This workflow is particularly suitable for progressively richer modeling. Saved geometry and field data retain the inputs needed for subsequent three-dimensional interpretation. Actual centerlines retain strand identity, arc length, and local position as inputs for model extension. Structural performance comparisons also require matched copper volume, return, end regions, and numerical uncertainty.
